title: overlord.yaml
description: Portable configuration for one Overlord canonical scope. See spec section 5.5.

external.description: Definitions visible in a native location but owned elsewhere. Scope is inferred from the configuration file containing the entry.

skillName.description: Spec section 6: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, with no leading, trailing, or consecutive hyphen.

agentName.description: Spec section 7.3: lowercase letters and hyphens, with no leading, trailing, or consecutive hyphen.

target.description: Required for agents. Optional for skills: omitted acknowledges native copies in both targets; supplied acknowledges only that target.

reason.description: Why this definition is owned elsewhere. Strongly recommended.
